info.title: TearsDeepMind API
info.description: Automated crawling service for financial forums analysis.

tags.name: Crawler Operations
tags.description: Endpoints for triggering and monitoring forum crawling tasks.

get.summary: Extract threads from a specific section
get.description: Triggers an asynchronous crawling task to extract forum threads from the specified section for the given number of days.

parameters.name: seccion
parameters.description: The section name to crawl (e.g., DailyAnalysis, QuantUpdates)

parameters.name: dias
parameters.description: Number of days to look back for threads

500.description: Internal server error starting the task.

get.description: Scans the specified section feed and returns a list of thread titles that have not been downloaded to the local filesystem for the current day.

parameters.name: seccion
parameters.description: The section to check (e.g., DailyAnalysis, QuantUpdates)

200.description: Check completed successfully. Returns list of new thread titles.
